_help: Public, safe to share: where the site finds its data. The family data itself is in Supabase (schema ervin_central), published from the private repo (private/ → scripts/publish.mjs); a device sees it only with its own key. key = the PUBLISHABLE key (never the secret one). pollSeconds = how often a visible screen checks for other devices’ changes. vapidPublicKey = the public half of the Web Push key (the private half lives only in ervin_central.push_config).
